body:
The test suite had 8 failing tests across 5 file suites due to a mix of misconfigured test exclusions, a missing jsdom polyfill, and a broken regex pattern.

## Changes

- **`vitest.config.ts`** ΓÇö Exclude `tests/e2e/**` (Playwright tests) and `tests/self-heal-integration.test.js` (standalone CLI script) from Vitest; neither uses Vitest's `describe`/`it`/`test` API
- **`vitest.setup.ts`** ΓÇö Add global `ResizeObserver` mock required by `react-use-measure` (used internally by `@react-three/fiber`); absence caused `EnergyCubeScene` and `PlasmaWaveField` tests to throw at render time
- **`tests/regression/critical-selectors.test.ts`** ΓÇö Fix spacing-class regex: `/^(p|m|gap|space)-[xy]?-\d+$/` ΓåÆ `/^(p|m|gap|space)(-[xy])?-\d+$/`; the original required a second `-` before the digit, making `p-4` unmatchable

```ts
// Before ΓÇö requires p--4 to match (broken)
/^(p|m|gap|space)-[xy]?-\d+$/

// After ΓÇö correctly matches p-4 and space-y-4
/^(p|m|gap|space)(-[xy])?-\d+$/
```

**Result:** `5 failed | 29 passed (34)` ΓåÆ `32 passed (32)`, 561/561 tests green.
